title: During a Showdown State (showdown active at Abandoned Hall, no chain, player-1 has Focus) the engine offered `activateAbility` for the legend Herald of the Arcane in step 31's legal moves, and in step 32 accepted it: energy 2->1, legend exhausted, and a create-token ability item was placed on the chain.
expected: Trace step 31 (showdownStack active, chain null, focusPlayer player-1) lists activateAbility for player-1-legend-ogn-265-298; step 32 shows energy 2->1 and a create-token ability item on the chain. Herald of the Arcane (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/herald-of-the-arcane.ts:16-25) declares the ability with no keyword/timing. In packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/chain/activate-ability.ts:49, abilityTimingClass returns "action" for any non-gear activated ability lacking an Action/Reaction keyword (`getCardType(hostCardId) === "gear" ? "standard" : "action"`), and chain/chain-state.ts:208 makes "action" legal in showdown-open. So the condition at activate-ability.ts:514-516 passes during a Showdown Open State. Rules 308.1.a ("Only cards and abilities with the Action or Reaction keywords can be played or activated in a Showdown State") and 343.1.b ("Card abilities, by default, cannot be played during a Showdown State") require default (keywordless) activated abilities to be neutral-open only; the engine's non-gear default of "action" violates this.
